text_to_image_prompt: Create the requested production spatial reference for an existing fictional Rian Thalys story location. Image 1 locks the connected spatial geometry; later images lock the existing visual appearance. Same one reception lounge shown by two supporting images. Navy curved sofa against decorated BACK wall, round gold/white coffee table in front, LEFT open arched doorway into hall, tall sea-view windows on RIGHT wall, one foreground blue seat, white stone gold filigree. Do not create two separate rooms. Consistent fixed furniture placement. Asset type: FOUR-VIEW ENVIRONMENT CONTACT SHEET, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, filling one portrait 9:16 canvas with narrow pale gutters. Four DIFFERENT actual camera views of ONE fixed location, not four new layouts: entry establishing view; reverse view from opposite end; left diagonal view; right diagonal view. Keep lighting/time, materials, number/positions of fixed anchors and adjacent openings consistent with the 3D reference. High-end detailed fantasy game rendering as original. All views at plausible camera height, not isometric. NO people. No text, no titles. Preserve exact existing anchors and materials. Unseen surfaces minimally completed, no new story props. Clear legible professional reference; no watermark.
